page.overview:
Who is Eiki Fūma?

Eiki is a very serious boy, eager to excel in his goals as a ninja. While very proper in his way of talking, taking pride in coming from a famous clan, he can be overconfident in his abilities and ultimately reckless. He has a crush on Kae Yukiwari, gets nervous when interacting with her, and gets jealous of other boys getting closer to her than him. Despite his self-important attitude, he was remorseful when his efforts to expose Kawaki as a shinobi ended up damaging the stage the rest of his class built. He is very brave, taking upon himself to investigate a terrorist threat, and staying behind to limit the potential size of an explosion.

Eiki is a fair-skinned boy of average height. He has amber eyes and dull grey hair that is buzzed on the bottom and parts to reach his ears on the top. He wears a black, long-sleeved shirt with a grey vest over it that has 3 downward-facing, yellow triangles lined up as one big triangle, and dark blue pants with black ninja sandals.

Descending from the Fūma Clan, Eiki is noted to have great talent for ninjutsu. He has shown capable skill with Shurikenjutsu, able to hit the target with multiple kunai thrown at once. He also had adept chakra control, as he was one of the quickest in his class to master the Tree Climbing Practice.

Upon starting at the Academy, Eiki quickly states his goals on becoming a ninja, making a good impression on everyone. When he dropped his handkerchief, Kae returned it to him, and he developed a crush on her. When Kawaki, older than any other student in the class, tried to befriend her, Eiki found him suspicious and was jealous. He attempted to force a spar against Kawaki, but he nonchalantly dodged all of Eiki's attacks. While having his injuries tended to, Eiki overheard the teachers talking about the tools storage room, and sneaked in, taking a summoning scroll. When he found Kawaki talking to Kae in a secluded spot, he attacked Kawaki with the summon, but was knocked unconscious by the summon, with whom he had no contract. Kawaki defeated it, and he and Kae left him there, certain he'd wake up with no lasting damage.
